correctness.rationale: The exhaustive integer-facet enumeration generates all 37 support facets from 1330 vertex triples. Exact gauge-shell enumeration in a bounding box covering 8Q gives all L(k) for k=0 through 8; the affine pyramid fibers are bijective with the two nonnegative integer apex parameters. Exact Ehrhart finite differences yield the claimed nine integers. Independent exact 3D facet triangulation gives normalized volume(Q)=1071, hence volume(P)=6*1071^2 matching the coefficient sum. An exact reciprocal quartic sign certificate shows four simple roots less than -2 and thus eight simple negative roots. The delivered verify.py was executed from its actual directory.

value.rationale: The complete Ehrhart/Hilbert series and its unexpectedly strict real-rootedness are mathematically natural invariants of the first explicit eight-dimensional reflexive facet-bound counterexample. They determine every dilation lattice count, provide exact normalized degree 6882246 and positive gamma spectrum, and inform the geometric-combinatorial relationship between high facet complexity and Ehrhart shape. This is a motivated, exact one-object invariant, not an arbitrary truncation or cosmetic parameter change.
